cases.reason: Return value is saved before LIFO cleanup and recover never runs.
Catch/trap across complete dynamic chain wins over even an earlier callee recover registration.
No matching catch across caller chain: cleanup precedes LIFO recovery, unchanged Error identity.
Raise bypasses every catch/trap but executes cleanup and nearest eligible recover.
No catch/trap/recover success for panic; terminal CONTROL independent of ordinary mailbox.
Cancellation cannot be recovered; no stale callback/Task revival; cleanup before resource retirement.
Re-entrant/failed exits must not execute a defer more than once.
RecoveryCursor.next is one-shot, terminal, nonescaping and cannot be reused.
Stronger cleanup failure is terminal and original error survives bounded suppression.
Unwind frame belongs to independently schedulable logical context, not carrier thread.
Sibling tasks and actors cannot share a mutable unwind stack.
Tenant and actor incarnation validate handler/capture provenance; no cross-tenant unwind.
Host traps are not silently reclassified into guest throw/raise.
Throw/raise/panic require nominal Error-subclass payload; reject unsupported source before artifact.
If suspension-safe cleanup and task-owned continuations are unproven, backend must fail closed.
Single non-callable statement evaluates only at scope exit, not registration.
Explicit factory evaluates once at registration; inner nullary closure invokes only on exit.
Named zero-argument callable uses the same cleanup stack as braced and braceless forms.
Failed registration does not install a partial cleanup and ordinary lexical throw is preserved.
Braceless await infers suspension and task cannot publish before cleanup completes.
Await inside assignment has the same suspension semantics as explicit susp defer.
Original ErrorView and terminal one-shot cursor authority survive suspension without escaping.
A locally handled ordinary throw is not converted to panic.
Unhandled callback error becomes authenticated terminal panic, preserving original cause and new error identity.
First panic remains primary; subsequent failures are ordered supplemental diagnostics.
Cancellation remains primary and records callback panic without successful recovery.
Uncaught recovery failure becomes panic and does not enter itself or another recovery callback.
Nested lexical cleanup drains before the surrounding callback finishes.
Unsafe mutable borrow or critical lock crossing cleanup await must fail closed before emission.
Ordinary braced defer does not silently admit await without explicit suspension effect.
Deferred callable must be nullary and recover callable must have exact two capability binders.
No stale wake, double callback, actor DATA reentry or premature retirement during cleanup.
Fallible Result returned from cleanup requires explicit handling or explicit discard, not implicit throw.
Reactor completion only admits a continuation; neither immediate settlement nor a host callback may execute a suspended cleanup outside the owning scheduler quantum.
A one-shot wakeup capability is consumed once; duplicate or foreign completion cannot execute cleanup or recovery twice or change the selected value.
Cancellation committed before recovery resumes dominates a successful recovery decision; the active callback must quiesce without reviving the cancelled task.
STOP or generation advance must not reclaim the logical context or physical storage until all active unwind callbacks and execution leases quiesce; stale completions cannot touch restarted actors.
Scalar intermediate stages run once in source order at registration; the final inline factory binds values, with LIFO cleanup only at exit.
Recovery captures fallback before failure; ordinary cleanup precedes the selected recovery callback and the original error remains visible.
Mismatched positional factory arity must fail closed before executable IR, Wasm or other guest artifact.

A source-compiled function accepting two pending typed Future<int> arguments must run braceless deferred awaits in reverse registration order, resume only through its owner scheduler, and publish its original return after cleanup.

A single owner lease must cover an ordinary pending body Future, deferred cleanup and pending recovery while preserving original error identity, no inline resumption and terminal cancellation precedence.

Sealed Future formals require explicit take ownership and atomic identity handoff; an accepted guest invocation cannot share or reuse its Future with another invocation, including an unselected recovery input.
